evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/j/a is the keyremapping config interface and preserves the Camera Remapping and F-key remapping sections, camera arrow-key replacements and F1..F12 replacement bindings.
RuneLite KeyRemappingConfig uses the same keyremapping package/config role and preserves the exact Camera Remapping section name and 'Settings for remapping the camera' description.
Concurrent source correction already identifies rs/s/j/b as KeyRemappingListener; sibling rs/s/j/c injects this config and carries the Key Remapping plugin descriptor.
Exact v308 rs/s/j/c carries plugin name 'Key Remapping' and the distinctive descriptor beginning 'Allows use of WASD keys for camera movement with Press Enter to Chat'.
The plugin injects rs/s/j/a KeyRemappingConfig and coordinates the already source-corrected rs/s/j/b KeyRemappingListener across plugin lifecycle/config changes.
RuneLite KeyRemappingPlugin preserves the same plugin name, WASD/Press Enter to Chat descriptor, enter/chat/wasd/camera tags and config/listener role.
